Claim 1 (Currently amended): A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; a plurality of ultrasound radiating members positioned within the energy delivery section, the plurality of ultrasound radiating members being allocated into electrical groups comprising more than one ultrasound radiating member; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group; and wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a spatial arrangement that is not solely regular.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a spatial arrangement that is not solely regular.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a spatial arrangement that is pseudo random. 

Claim 6 (Currently amended): A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: a first and a second ultrasound catheter, each of the first and the second ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen; and a control system connected to and configured to operate at least one elongate inner core of each of the first and the second ultrasound catheter.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A method for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the method comprising: advancing an ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen; advancing the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter to a treatment site in the patient's pulmonary artery; inflating a balloon on the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter; delivering a thrombolytic drug to the treatment site through the at least one fluid delivery lumen; and emitting ultrasonic energy to promote diffusion of the thrombolytic drug at the treatment site. 

Claim 11 (Currently amended): An ultrasound catheter for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen, the tubular body defining a guidewire lumen extending through the proximal portion to the ultrasound energy delivery section and not solely through the at least one ultrasound element.
